verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official MCP server that lets an AI tool of choice read workspace data and create and manage automations, one-time sends and segments through natural language. Its docs separate read, write and delete permissions so each category can be approved independently, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and concrete connection or authentication setup details in the evidence.
